Container.Name: nextcloud-sync
Container.Overview:
Automatically sync a local Unraid folder with your Nextcloud using the official nextcloudcmd client.
Features: - Continuous sync mode with configurable interval - Optional one-time run mode - Retry logic for temporary network/server issues - Non-root runtime (UID/GID 1001) - Minimal, security-focused Debian Trixie base image
Recommended: use a Nextcloud app password/token instead of your main account password.
Container.DonateText: If you find this container useful, consider supporting the developer

Config.Name: Nextcloud Username
Config.Description: Your Nextcloud username. This is the username you use to log into your Nextcloud instance.

Config.Name: Nextcloud Password/Token
Config.Description: Your Nextcloud app password or token. For security reasons, it's highly recommended to create an app-specific password in Nextcloud Settings → Security → Devices & sessions instead of using your main password.

Config.Name: Nextcloud Server URL
Config.Description: Your Nextcloud server hostname or URL. Examples: cloud.example.com or https://cloud.example.com

Config.Name: Sync Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Time interval between synchronization attempts in seconds. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes). Increase for less frequent syncs or decrease for more frequent syncs.

Config.Name: Sync Retry Attempts
Config.Description: Number of retry attempts when synchronization fails (1-10 range). The container uses exponential backoff between retry attempts. Increase this value for unstable network connections. v2.7 includes enhanced retry logic with improved error handling and modern client compatibility.

Config.Name: Run Once Mode
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to run synchronization once and exit, or 'false' for continuous operation. Use 'true' for scheduled one-time syncs via Unraid User Scripts.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to enable verbose nextcloudcmd debug output (useful for troubleshooting).

Config.Name: Local Data Directory
Config.Description: Local directory path synchronized with your Nextcloud account. Must be writable by the container.
